summary: Ubuntu 5.10 (Breezy Badger) was released on 12 October 2005. New features included a graphical bootloader (Usplash), Add/Remove Applications tool, Alacarte menu editor, easy language selector, logical volume management support, full HP printer support, OEM installer support, a new Ubuntu logo in the top-left, and Launchpad integration for bug reporting and software development.
notes: Unsupported since 2007-04-13. Kernel 2.6.12. Support period was 18 months for interim releases until 13.04 when it was reduced to 9 months.
